title: Learning from Long-Tailed Noisy Data with Sample Selection and Balanced Loss

anchors.quote: we adopt a two-component (g1 and g0 ) Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) for each class
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 方法在每个观测类别内部对交叉熵损失拟合两分量 GMM，以干净分量后验概率是否超过二分之一来划分有标签干净集 L 与无标签集 U。

anchors.quote: On CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, mini-ImageNet-Red and Animal-10N, we use an 18-layer PreAct ResNet and train for 200 epochs.
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 主实验覆盖合成与真实长尾噪声数据；CIFAR 等使用 PreAct-ResNet-18 训练 200 轮，Clothing1M/Food-101N 用 ResNet-50，WebVision 用 Inception-ResNet v2。

ABLATIONS.pages: 8-9, Table 6, Figure 1, Table 7, and Appendix D

anchors.paraphrase_zh: 消融分别移除基于模型偏差的重平衡、改用标签频率、移除 Lreg、将分类别 GMM 换成全局单 GMM，并扫描抑制与放松超参数。

LIMITATIONS.absence_reason_zh: 全文没有独立局限章节，也未系统讨论基于测试集报告 Best 值、随机初始化次数、未知真实噪声率与跨数据分布迁移造成的不确定性。

formulas: For each observed class i, cross-entropy losses L(D_i) are modeled by a two-component GMM; P(g1 | loss) > 1/2 defines the clean subset.
M_ij^t averages the current model probability of predicting class j over selected labeled samples observed as class i, and EMA gives Mbar^t = sigma Mbar^(t-1) + (1-sigma) M^t.
R_ij = Mbar_ij / Mbar_ji and alpha_ij = R_ij^g(R_ij), with separate suppression and relaxation exponents in the balanced supervised loss.
The final objective is L = L'_L + lambda_u L_U + lambda_reg L_reg.
algorithm_steps: Warm up the network on all noisy long-tailed data with cross-entropy plus a class-balanced output regularizer.
At every post-warm-up epoch, fit a separate two-component GMM to losses within each observed class and partition examples into labeled-clean L and unlabeled U.
Use MixMatch on mini-batches from L and U while estimating a class-to-class model-bias matrix, then stabilize it with an EMA.
After the bias-estimation phase, keep refreshing CASS and optimize the bias-balanced supervised loss plus unsupervised and regularization terms until the fixed endpoint.
variables: observed class-specific sample counts n_c and imbalance ratio rho
per-example cross-entropy loss and GMM clean posterior
clean labeled set L and unlabeled set U
model-bias matrix M, EMA matrix Mbar, pairwise ratio R_ij, and weight alpha_ij
warm-up, bias-estimation, and total epoch endpoints
lambda_u, lambda_reg, sigma, gamma_sup, and gamma_rel
selection_timing: After a dataset-specific warm-up, CASS is executed at the start of every subsequent epoch before optimizer mini-batches are drawn; the partition therefore depends on the current model state.
refresh_rule: The clean/noisy partition is refreshed every epoch by refitting per-class two-component GMMs to current losses; the model-bias matrix is refreshed during its estimation phase and temporally averaged by EMA.

budget.unit: optimizer-visible labeled and unlabeled mini-batch examples per training iteration
budget.denominator: the entire noisy long-tailed training set, repartitioned each epoch into L and U
budget.unique_sample_definition: The paper identifies examples by their membership in L or U for the current epoch but does not report cumulative unique selected IDs across epochs.
budget.repeat_definition: An example can be selected as clean in many successive epochs or reused as an unlabeled example; the paper does not publish a per-example repeat histogram.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Cumulative optimizer-visible exposure for L and U is not tabulated, and the method is not matched to a random selector at equal exposure.
budget.compute_cost: Each post-warm-up epoch adds class-wise loss collection and GMM fitting; MixMatch augmentation and pseudo-labeling also add compute beyond ordinary supervised training.

random_baselines: ERM on all noisy long-tailed data
Co-teaching, ELR+, DivideMix, H2E, MW-Net, HAR-DRW, and long-tail-adjusted DivideMix variants
No global-random or class-matched-random selector with the same selected count, epoch timing, cumulative exposure, and optimizer steps is reported.
datasets: long-tailed CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with symmetric or asymmetric synthetic noise
checkpoint_selection: Tables report both Best and Last test accuracy. The paper does not define an independent validation-only checkpoint rule, so Best is potentially test-oracle selected; only fixed Last values are safe for transfer claims.

results.claim: 在 CIFAR-100 对称噪声率 0.5、长尾比 100 的最难列中，固定末轮 SSBL 高于固定末轮 DivideMix 和 ERM。
results.value: SSBL Last 36.49%; DivideMix Last 34.51%; ERM Last 14.47% test accuracy.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: SSBL 的固定末轮在最极端 CIFAR-100 设置取得 36.49%，相对 DivideMix 的 34.51% 有提升，但论文未报告跨 seed 方差。

results.claim: 将分类别选择改为所有类别共享一个 GMM 会显著降低平均测试准确率。
results.value: SSBL mean 48.33%; without class-aware sample selection mean 38.74%.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 在 Table 6 的六个 CIFAR-100 组合上，全局单 GMM 版本平均值比完整分类别方法低 9.59 个百分点。

ablations: replace model-bias rebalancing with ordinary cross-entropy
estimate rebalancing from label frequency rather than model bias
remove Lreg only during warm-up or throughout training
replace class-aware GMMs with one global GMM
reuse CASS partitions with DARP and ABC
negative_results: A global GMM over all observed classes performs much worse than class-aware selection in the ablation.
Too little or too much head-class suppression and excessive tail-class relaxation degrade accuracy.
Removing Lreg for the full process collapses some extreme long-tail settings.
The paper does not establish exposure-matched utility against random selection or cross-seed directional stability.
failure_conditions: Per-class loss distributions do not separate clean from noisy examples or are too small to fit a stable two-component GMM.
Observed class is too corrupted for a class-conditional GMM to represent a coherent population.
Best test accuracy is treated as a deployable checkpoint despite the lack of an independent checkpoint-selection split.
Stage1 reuses the clean-posterior rule as replay utility without matching random exposure, optimizer steps, and model-state lag.
limitations: No strict global-random or method-matched-random sample-selection control is provided.
No cumulative unique-ID, repeat, optimizer-visible exposure, or optimizer-step ledger is reported.
Independent training-seed counts and worst-seed outcomes are not reported.
The target is overall multiclass accuracy under label noise and imbalance, not FN95 or a local safety frontier.
Selection and the new balanced loss change together, so their causal contributions are not fully isolated by the main comparisons.
The paper reports Best test accuracy alongside Last, creating a potential test-oracle interpretation.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该论文直接支持 Q 与集合条件 D 的顺序门控思路：先在来源或类别分层内估计标签可靠性，避免跨分层比较不可比的 loss，再让未判为可靠的样本保留为无标签候选而非简单丢弃。对 Stage1 可迁移的是分层可靠性门控和每轮刷新机制；它不提供 R 或 FN95 方向 A 的证据，也没有证明被选样本应获得额外 replay 曝光。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 不能从 SSBL 的准确率提升推出有限预算动态回流有效，因为 CASS、半监督 MixMatch、平衡损失和正则项同时改变，且没有累计曝光匹配的 global random、method-matched random、current-loss 与 no-replay。Stage1 若借鉴，只能把 class/source-aware Q 当析因门控，并必须在固定基础训练、固定 replay slots、固定 steps 和未见 training seeds 下单独检验 utility。
